en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2487 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) forbade stepping over the camel line (caravan).

It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), why?"
Prophet (sw) replied: "Because there is not a single camel line except that between one camel and the next there is a devil."
